title: Neuropsychological Effects After CAR-T-Cell-Therapy
summary: This project investigates the cognitive effects of CAR-T cell therapy in patients with hematologic malignancies. The focus is on the onset and course of cognitive changes associated with cytokine release syndrome (CRS) and immune effector cell-associated neurotoxicity syndrome (ICANS). Both syndromes are known, potentially serious side effects of this form of therapy and may be associated with both acute and long-term cognitive impairments. However, a detailed description of the neurocognitive changes following CAR-T cell therapy has not yet been conducted.

interventions.name:
Prospective:
Neuropsychological testing will be conducted at a total of five time points: a baseline assessment (before the start of therapy), three interim assessments (acute and subacute phases), and a follow-up assessment (after 6 months).

Retrospective:
Pseudonymized data already available from routine clinical practice will be analyzed retrospectively. The analysis will include data collected between 01.07.2022 and 30.09.2025.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients receiving CAR-T-cell-therapy at the University Hospital Augsburg
Exclusion criteria:
none
